evidence.observation: Thermocouple reads 749.6 °C against 750.0 °C setpoint; growth temperature has settled after initial overshoot.
Measured argon flow is 100.2 sccm against 100.0 sccm setpoint.
Exhaust oxygen sensor and pressure gauge are not installed; atmosphere cannot be verified from argon flow alone.
Heater power is 45.4% and controller reports running; no demonstrated fault in monitored channels.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen and tube-pressure measurements are needed to verify the growth atmosphere; sample characterization is needed to assess target growth.
